summary: Tested the four Analyzer/Report consistency guards end-to-end. Backend: parity test 2/2 green, golden snapshot green, and a new HTTP suite (7 tests) covering POST /api/config-fingerprint, fingerprint on /api/projection and /api/strategy-sweep, determinism, and structural-vs-full hash semantics — all pass. Frontend (real UI, master PIN login): Guard 1 verified on both surfaces (strategy-run-on and cr-cover-run-on) with the SAME 16-hex hash (#aab79e66459668cd) for an unchanged plan; Guard 4 label harmonization verified (new labels + subtitle + hover defs present, no 'Legacy @ 2nd death' / 'Value @ 2nd death' anywhere); Guard 2 'apply does NOT trip staleness' verified; Guard 2 staleness banner/disabled-Apply/re-run-clears verified via a same-tab structural change (header Reset to defaults). One real defect: the sweep result state is destroyed on ANY tab switch, so the intended flow in the spec (run sweep -> edit Plan Inputs -> return to Analyzer -> stale banner) NEVER shows the banner; the Analyzer shows the empty 'Run the sweep...' state instead.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix TabsContent for value='strategy' is not force-mounted, so StrategyOptimizer unmounts on every tab switch and its local state (result, sweepFp, runStamp, currentFp) is lost. Verified: run sweep -> switch to 'Conversion and Plan Controls' -> back to Strategy => strategy-winner count 0, strategy-empty count 1. Consequence: the STALENESS GUARD is unreachable via the specified flow (edit an account balance in Plan Inputs then return to the Analyzer) — no strategy-config-stale banner can ever render after leaving the tab. Fix: lift sweep result + fingerprints to Planner state (or forceMount the strategy TabsContent) so results survive tab navigation.

issues: When a structural input changes, BOTH strategy-sweep-stale (amber) and strategy-config-stale (red) banners render simultaneously with overlapping messages — consider suppressing the amber banner when the red config-stale banner is shown.

Pre-existing React console warning (only in the preview instrumentation build): '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from the strategy-sweep-horizon select (StrategyOptimizer.jsx ~line 492). Low priority, no functional impact.

action_items: Persist the strategy sweep result + config fingerprints across tab switches (lift to Planner or forceMount the strategy tab) so the staleness guard actually fires after editing Plan Inputs and returning to the Analyzer.
Optional: suppress the amber 'ranking is from an earlier sweep' banner when the red config-stale banner is displayed (duplicate messaging).
critical_code_review_comments: StrategyOptimizer holds all guard state locally while the parent Tabs unmounts inactive content — any guard that depends on comparing a past run to the live plan must live above the tab boundary.
applyStrategy's resultsStale toast path is unreachable from the UI (both Apply buttons are disabled while stale) — harmless defense-in-depth, keep it.
config_fingerprint's structural_hash correctly excludes roth/withdrawal (verified over HTTP: applying roth+funding_order leaves structural_hash identical while the full hash changes).

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9: 7 new HTTP fingerprint tests + 2 parity tests, plus golden snapshot green)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (Guards 1, 1b, 4 and apply-does-not-trip pass; Guard 2 logic passes only when the Analyzer stays mounted)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Money inputs in Plan Inputs are readOnly until focused — click the input first, then fill (e.g. [data-testid='acc-bal-0']). cr-cover-run-on resolves to 2 nodes (preview + print root) — use .first. A full sweep takes ~15-25s. To exercise the config-stale banner without unmounting the Analyzer, run the sweep on a perturbed plan and then click header [data-testid='reset-defaults-btn'] -> reset-defaults-confirm while staying on the Strategy tab.
rca_of_the_issue: Guard 2 unreachable via the spec'd flow: <TabsContent value='strategy'> in Planner.jsx (line ~377) has no forceMount, so Radix unmounts StrategyOptimizer when the user navigates to Plan Inputs. On return the component remounts with result=null/sweepFp=null, and configStale (which requires !!result && sweepFp.structural_hash) is false by construction — the user sees strategy-empty instead of the staleness banner. The guard logic itself is correct: forcing a same-tab structural change (Reset to defaults after running a sweep on an edited plan) rendered the exact banner text, disabled both Apply leader and row-0 Apply, and re-running the sweep cleared the banner and re-enabled Apply.
